Drop hidden text by default

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, BrowserConfig, ContentConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        browser=BrowserConfig(mode="never"),
        content=ContentConfig(exclude_selectors=[], extract_metadata=False, preprocessing_preset="minimal", remove_forms=False, remove_navigation=False),
        respect_robots_txt=False,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
